result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to diminish the barriers between people.

I see so much division and misunderstanding in the world, based on differences in beliefs, cultures, and experiences. If everyone could better understand and empathize with each other, I believe many of the world's problems could be solved.

We are all human beings, sharing this planet. Focusing on our commonalities instead of our differences would create a more peaceful, compassionate, and just world.
